The doctor also completed multiple high-order opportunities, especially correcting the “just neuralgia” framing, verifying both vascular and nonvascular interpretations, and dynamically shifting priorities from urgent ED evaluation to observation, written medication reconciliation, then cardiology/neurology follow-up.
